shared_elements: animal or creature head depicted in relief/sculpted form
justification: Both surfaces are worked upright stone blocks with schematic, low-relief carved creature features — most specifically a row of animal heads with hollowed eyes and heavy brows in A, echoed by the single hollow-eyed, browed face in B. But A is a densely populated multi-register composition of quadrupeds, birds, a snake and abstract bands with figures in specific spatial relations, whereas B depicts only a single isolated head/face with no accompanying figures, motifs or scene.
